name: uSkin Patch uSPa 44

sources.title: Products - XELA Robotics (uSkin sensors)
sources.covers: uSkin Patch (uSPa) models: sensing points, dimensions, cables; grippers and hands they fit

note: A contact sensor, modelled by pad coverage, not a workspace camera, so it has no imagers. A magnetic (Hall-effect) 3-axis tactile patch: each sensing point (taxel) measures X, Y shear and Z normal force (XELA's description of uSkin). pad_mm is the stated module footprint (the sensing area within it is not given separately). Not stated on the product page: sampling rate, force range, power, mass, the host interface (XELA sells a controller; not read). Its readings are not an image stream, so no stream is entered; the bandwidth budget needs the data rate as a measured or stated figure. uSPa 44: "16 sensing points, 23 x 25 x 5 mm, single 7-wire cable"; listed for the UMI gripper and the Allegro Hand V4. size_mm [5, 23, 25]: the 5 mm thickness along the pad normal (body x), an ASSUMPTION on which side is which.
